title: Nasty Multipack 3mg 10ml E-Liquids (70VG/30PG)
description:
Available in a pack of 5, these Nasty Juice flavoured Multipacks offer vapers long lasting vaping experiences with any of these nine original classic Nasty Juice flavours. Each bottle contains up to 10ml of the same flavour with a high VG level that’s ideally suited for Mouth to Lung (MTL) and Pod vaping due to the higher PG to VG ratio e-liquid as they are runnier than 50/50 ones and have slightly stronger throat hits. All of these 10ml Nasty Juice Multipacks are fully complaint with TPD regulations and standards, offering both guaranteed safe and premium quality e-liquids on offer. These come in 3mg nicotine but they are also available in 0mg and 6mg strengths.
– Made in Malaysia
– 3mg Nicotine
– 5 x 10ml Bottles
– 70VG/30PG
– Ideal for Mouth to Lung & Pod Vaping
– Childproof Cap and Tamper Evident Seal
– Recyclable Bottle and Box
– TPD Compliant
Flavours:
Fatboy
Bad Blood
Devil Teeth
Wicked Haze
Slow Blow
Asap Grape
Trap Queen
Green Ape
Cushman
